segments.en: [This letter opens mid-sentence in the source text.]

…Who subdues and nullifies the vanity and the spirit of foolishness and madness of the external wisdoms and the false faiths. And through his power he will bring everything close to Hashem Yisburach — even the nations of the world. And draws down the revelation of His G-dliness in the world — to serve Him in unison. And the whole earth will be filled with knowledge — to know Hashem.
